newsitem.title: USA: CME to name search committee to replace Brodsky.
newsitem.headline: CME to name search committee to replace Brodsky.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange will soon name a search committee to find a replacement for William Brodsky, exchange chairman Jack Sandner said in a statement Wednesday.
Brodsky, CME president and chief executive officer since 1985, was earlier appointed chairman and CEO of the Chicago Board Options Exchange.

Sandner said in a statement that after Brodsky leaves the CME, Jerry Beyer, executive vice president and chief administrative officer, will handle internal affairs and Rick Kilcollin, executive vice president for business development, will handle external affairs.
The CBOE has not set a specific date when Brodsky will take office. Brodsky will replace the CBOE's Alger "Duke" Chapman who plans to retire in 1997.
